description: Run one-call distillation (Gridline's /distillation/jobs): the teacher model answers your prompts in a batch, the answers become a fine-tuning file with held-out rows, the student base is fine-tuned on it, and (unless run_student_batch is false) the new ft: model answers the held-out prompts so you can compare it with the teacher. Give your prompts as prompts_file (a file id from upload_file, purpose "batch") or prompts (a local JSONL path this tool uploads first), not both; one prompt a line: {"messages": [...]} ending with the user's turn, or an OpenAI batch request line. Prompt baking: student_system trains the student on a shorter prompt than the teacher saw, so each request it serves later carries fewer input tokens. Omit it (or null) to keep the full prompt, "" to train with no system message, or text (at most 2,048 bytes, not blank) as the student's short system line; the held-out student batch asks the same shorter prompt and the quote counts it. Unset options take the server's defaults. Costs credit unless dry_run is true: a distillation job runs three stages, each billed as the ordinary batch or fine-tune it is: the teacher's batch over your prompts (batch price, per-batch minimum), the student fine-tune (per trained token, per-job minimum) and, unless run_student_batch is false, a student batch over the held-out prompts (https://gridlinegpu.com/pricing). Send dry_run: true first: it returns the quote (object distillation.quote, with max_total_usd, the sum of each stage's maximum, and each stage's bound) and creates nothing. spend_cap_usd refuses a job whose quote is over it (spend_cap_exceeded). Requires confirm_spend: true unless dry_run is true. Then poll get_distillation.

confirm_spend.description: Must be true for this call to run: you have read the quote or price and accept the charge.

dry_run.description: true: return the quote only; no job is created and nothing is charged (a local prompts file is still uploaded, free).

keep_truncated.description: Keep teacher answers cut at max_tokens in the training file (default false: they are left out, still billed).

max_tokens.description: Teacher answer limit (default 1,024 or the teacher's own limit).

prompts.description: Local path of a prompts JSONL to upload instead of prompts_file.

prompts_file.description: File id of the prompts (purpose batch, from upload_file).

run_student_batch.description: Run the ft: model on the held-out prompts (default true).

spend_cap_usd.description: Refuse the job if the quote's max_total_usd is over this.

student.description: Student base model id (a fine-tune base).

student_system.description: Prompt baking. Omit or null: the student trains on the prompt as the teacher saw it. "": no system message. Text: this short system message instead of yours.

teacher.description: Teacher model id: any chat model list_models shows for you.

validation_split.description: Share of prompts held out, 0 up to 1 (default 0.1).
